explanation: Only nonzero at GO when the agent chooses a2 and the previous trial was rewarded: about 10 on the first rewarded trial after one or more unrewarded trials (mostly mid-episode, trials 40-70), then dropping to about 4, 2 and 0 over further rewarded trials in a row; the same situation early in the episode (before trial 40) gives only 1-2, choosing a1 gives 0-3. It is 0 at every D1 and D2 step, at GO after an unrewarded trial, and at GO whenever the agent chooses a1.
